title: Don’t wait, order it now!
text: Don’t wait, order it now!. This island exceeded my expectations beyond measure! It’s very heavy, sturdy, and delightful to look at! Right now I enjoy looking at it. Perhaps at thanksgiving I’ll put a charcuterie board/platter on it, yum!

product_metadata.title: Home Styles Americana Kitchen Island, Black
features: Crafted of hardwood solids and veneers, with engineered woods, with a Black painted body, and a physically distressed oak finished Top, which features Worm holes, fly specking, and small indentations.
One single easy-glide pass through drawer that is accessible from both sides with full Depth storage.
Two doors on each side open to a storage are with a single adjustable shelf.
Delivered to your door by parcel post service
Two stationary side shelves on each side with lower base storage areas complete the functionality of this compact island
Ships in several boxes, may ship separately
description: Add a stylish way to make the most of your kitchen storage space with this Homestyles Americana Kitchen Island. The hardwood top sits on a durable engineered wood frame, which features antique brass finished hardware. Loaded with open and closed storage options, it combines modern conveniences with a classic aesthetic.

details.Included Components: 5082-941_Kitchen Island Top, 5082-942_Kitchen Island Body, Kitchen Island
